name: wanderlist
description: Read your travel itineraries, create trips, and add suggested activities to Wanderlist.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Wanderlist account to read your trips, create private itineraries, and add suggested activities to days you can edit. Activities are saved to Wanderlist; this plugin does not purchase tickets or make reservations.
defaultPrompt: Show my upcoming trips in Wanderlist.
Help me plan a weekend trip and save it to Wanderlist.
Add a dinner suggestion to my Wanderlist itinerary.

positive.description: List owned and shared sample trips.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected review account's Paris review itinerary and read-only sample, without trips from other accounts.

positive.prompt: Show the days and activities in my Paris review itinerary.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the sample trip's exact dates and activities with its Wanderlist link. Exclude documents, messages, and participant profile data.

positive.description: Create a private trip after user approval.
positive.prompt: Save a two-day Barcelona trip for February 10–11, 2027 in Wanderlist. I approve saving this plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one private trip for the connected account with two itinerary days. No reservations or payments occur.

positive.description: Append an activity to an existing day.
positive.prompt: Add lunch at 12:30 on February 1, 2027 to my Paris review itinerary.
positive.expected_behavior: Append one food activity to the requested day, preserving existing activities and ownership.

positive.description: Retry a save without duplicating it.
positive.prompt: Retry that exact lunch addition with the same requestId.
positive.expected_behavior: Return alreadyAdded without creating a second activity. Reuse the UUID from the previous tool request.

negative.description: A trip code does not grant access outside the connected account.
negative.prompt: Read trip ZZ0000 even though it does not belong to my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject access without exposing whether an unrelated trip exists or returning its contents.

negative.description: Viewer permissions prevent edits to the shared read-only sample.
negative.prompt: Add dinner to the read-only review itinerary shared with me as Viewer.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the edit and preserve the shared sample itinerary.

negative.description: Reconnect with only trips:read before running this case; the server must enforce scope independently of the prompt.
negative.prompt: Create a new Wanderlist trip using my read-only connection.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the write and explain that trips:write must be approved through reconnection.

review.commerce_description: Saves suggested trip plans only. Does not book, purchase, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: secure account linking, trip listing, itinerary reading, private trip creation, activity additions, retry protection, and connection revocation.
